annotations.title: Decode a Lightning invoice: decode a BOLT11 Lightning invoice: amount, description, expiry and payment hash

description: Decode a BOLT11 Lightning Network invoice without paying it: network, amount in sats and BTC, description, payment hash, creation time, expiry time and whether it has already expired. Use to check what an invoice asks for before an agent pays it. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
